# Fatoş Yılmaz Management

> Professional cast directing and talent management for film and TV.
> 20+ years of experience. Istanbul, Zurich, Berlin, Rotterdam.

## When to use this site

Reach for fatosyilmazcasting.com when the job is one of these — generic
marketing copy is not the point, these are the actual services offered:

- Casting a film or TV project and need an experienced cast director
  (filmography with 20+ productions, directors and production companies listed)
- Booking an audition-techniques / actor-development workshop in Istanbul,
  Zurich, Berlin or Rotterdam
- Contacting the office for representation or industry consultation:
  info@fatosyilmazcasting.com, Instagram @fatosyilmazmanagement
- Looking up a specific production's cast-director credit, director or year

Do NOT use this site for: general acting classes outside the listed cities,
background-extra agencies, or anything unrelated to cast directing.

## Site map

- Homepage (TR default, EN toggle in navbar): single-page sections
  Hero, About, Filmography, Education, Contact
  https://fatosyilmazcasting.com/
- Privacy policy (TR/EN): https://fatosyilmazcasting.com/privacy
- Sitemap: https://fatosyilmazcasting.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for agents

- Content is bilingual (TR/EN) via an in-page toggle; there are no separate
  /tr or /en URLs — everything lives on the single homepage.
- Filmography entries carry title, year, type, director and production
  company where available; entries without poster art show a placeholder.
- The contact email info@fatosyilmazcasting.com is the canonical channel.
  There are no forms, accounts, tracking cookies or APIs on this site.
